data.subject: ecoPTO Dance Nite on 10/23, Hopewell Train Station!
data.intro:
Hello ecoPTO!

Save the date, book a babysitter, and join us for a grown-ups only Dance Nite on 10/23, 7pm-10pm, at the Hopewell Train Station! Details here:

[https://ecopto.org/events/2026-09-21-dance-nite/](https://ecopto.org/events/2026-09-21-dance-nite/)
